meta.title: ISOGEN symbol keys (SKEY) used by the 05 ISO MVP export and the isometric symbol library
meta.note: The ISOGEN Symbol Key (SKEY) Definitions Reference Guide (Hexagon, 2016) was located (S9) but not readable from the sandbox; rows come from search extracts of it and of the AVEVA ISODRAFT manual. SKEY = 2 characters for the component family + 2 characters for the end condition (BW, SW, FL, CP, SC, PL). An SKEY not listed here is exported only when the user supplies it (catalogue field `skey`); llull never invents one.

rows.meaning: flange, slip-on (as listed by one source)
tee set-on (plain end), PypeServer TEE-SET example
field-fitted weld (extra length left on the pipe, trimmed on site)
